text:
Anna: Hey team — I posted the PRD draft for the inference-routing rollout. Link: https://redwood.in/drive/prd/inference-routing-draft 

Micah: quick Q — are we locking a latency SLO for the new routing? I didn’t see explicit numbers in the PRD. Also need a fallback plan if dedicated capacity is saturated.

Anna: good call. Proposed SLOs are in the metrics section but not called out clearly. TL;DR: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms for hosted tier. Fallback: route to compatible model variant in other region, or degrade to cached responses for 5s window. Comments welcome.

Samir: UI/UX note — the product needs a status indicator for degraded routing (suggest a small banner on admin console). I sketched a tiny flow in the doc.

Jules: infra checklist: we need capacity reservations for Dedicated pools, DB migration for routing rules, and a schema change for route metadata. Also need a canary window with 1% traffic first.

Meera: adding a decision-log entry is mandatory before sign-off. Can someone own the decision text? Also we should add a rollback playbook in the acceptance checklist.

Anna: I can draft the decision-log blurb and the rollback steps. Will attach by EOD today.

Micah: for acceptance criteria, propose the following minimal set: 
```
- End-to-end latencies meet SLOs under 95th percentile on staging load tests
- Fallback triggers when queue latency > 200ms for 30s
- No regression on token-cost per request > 2%
- Canary pass criteria: error rate <= 0.5% for 2h at 1% traffic
```
Those are measurable in existing dashboards.

Samir: edge case to add: downstream model variant may return different tokenization causing prompt mismatch. Add a test prompt set to detect semantic drift.

Jules: ops details — schedule maintenance window for the schema migration (2h), and ensure we have a hotfix playbook if the migration increases DB write latency.

Meera: ok owners? Anna will own decision log and rollback. Micah to add SLO numbers + test harness. Jules owns infra runbook and canary. Samir to add UI mock and semantic drift tests. I’ll maintain the checklist and track approvals.

ReleaseBot: Reminder: planned canary window next Thu 09:00 UTC unless changed. Please update the calendar if you need to reschedule.

Anna: action items assigned in the PRD comments. Quick ask to stakeholders: please add a short approval comment ('approve' or 'needs changes') in-thread once you confirm your area.

Micah: approve. I’ll drop the SLOs + staging test script by 1400 PST. :thumbsup: 

Samir: needs changes — will add drift tests and the admin banner before tomorrow morning.

Jules: approve, but will need the migration runbook reviewed by Eng-Infra. Tagging them in PRD.

Meera: noted. I’ll publish the launch checklist and decision log link once Anna adds the decision text. Targeting Wed noon for final sign-off.

Anna: thanks all — I’ll post the decision-log entry and the rollback playbook within 3 hours. Ping me if you want to pair on acceptance metrics.

Micah: thanks — pairing sounds good.

Samir: thanks everyone.

Jules: thanks — marking in my calendar.

Meera: I’ll send a final reminder tomorrow morning. :bell: 

Anna: closing the loop — everyone please put your one-line approval (approve / needs changes) directly in this thread when you’re done.

ReleaseBot: Signing off: automated reminder will post 12h before the canary.

Micah: approve
note: This thread contains short, cross-functional coordination messages for PRD review and sign-off.
